name: tests-50pct-kwatch-durable-insight-delivery-outbox
instr:
kwatch cannot durably deliver insight lifecycles across failures, restarts, retries, and graceful shutdown while preserving provider order and routing decisions. Make unfinished announcements recoverable without repeating correlation or diagnosis.

Record every lifecycle occurrence before transport with a stable, provider-scoped identity. DingTalk, FeiShu, Google Chat, Mattermost, Rocket.Chat, Discord, Slack, and Matrix must use their existing transport semantics to classify attempted lifecycle deliveries from locally supplied evidence, without network credentials, as acknowledged, rejected, or indeterminate, while preserving diagnostic details. Acknowledged and rejected attempts become terminal. Indeterminate attempts retain identical identities and payloads through persistence and replay. Each provider stream delivers create, updates, and resolved in lifecycle order without blocking unrelated streams. Restored work precedes new emissions. Preserve routes and fallback decisions after configuration changes. Snapshots retain the existing incident representation, round-trip deterministically through ConfigMap storage, and deterministically retain work and report omissions when capacity is insufficient.

Shutdown freezes admission, waits for active attempts, retires acknowledged work, and saves stranded unfinished work without changing existing shutdown sequencing. Preserve existing Provider, ThreadProvider, and InsightThreadProvider behavior, including ActionSkip and synchronou
